# count => n;  paused => 0/1;  actuatorson => 0/1
# params: kind dur gain delay dir env(al,at,fl,ft or -) mag rs re off phase period cond(off,pc,nc,ps,ns,db)
# times are microseconds; 4294967295 is INFINITE
